what.text: This page follows refugees from Israel in all host countries, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 1265 Israeli refugees, and the United Kingdom hosted 10.8% of them.
After the United Kingdom, the largest hosts are Germany, Canada and Spain.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Palestine territory in Israel in periods from 1983 to 2025, and over Southern Lebanon territory in periods from 1990 to 2025.
It also records an interstate armed conflict between Iran and Israel from 2018 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1988 at 5 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 1539, at the end of 2007.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1994 to 1998, 2006 to 2015 and 2022 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
